invariants.rationale: The upsertPrepped method always returns the result of execute(), which is expected to be non-null HoodieWriteMetadata.
HoodieWriteMetadata instances typically maintain a map of partition write statistics; this is expected to be non-null upon successful execution.
HoodieWriteMetadata is parameterized to hold List<WriteStatus>, expected to be non-null after a successful upsert operation.
A List's size() is always non-negative; this checks basic consistency of the return value.
The method requires a non-null execution context to perform any upsert operation.
